title: Buy-side swept, short from the gap
prompt: It is 09:50 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: The Daily and 4H have been trending down. Use them for bias, then look at the 5m for a way in once price has done something at the open.
intro.advanced: 09:50 ET. Mark what matters and decide.

whyNot.label: the bullish 5m gap at 09:55
whyNot.why: It formed inside the pullback, against the move down. A gap in the opposite direction after a sweep and displacement is the retrace itself, not a setup to buy.

whyNot.label: selling at market now
whyNot.why: Price has already left the entry area. The edge was in the gap the displacement left, well above where price is now.

reference.summary: Bearish higher timeframes, buy-side liquidity swept at the open, displacement through the last 5m low, and a retrace into the gap it left, with the previous day low as the draw.

bias.why: The Daily and 4H are making lower highs and lower lows, and the overnight rally into a 1H gap was a pullback inside that trend.

options.note: A rally can look like a reversal, but nothing broke the downtrend

decision.why: A sweep, displacement and a defined entry area with a clear draw is a valid short. Waiting for the retrace into the gap is just as sound; selling at market after the move is not.

draw.why: The previous day low is the obvious pool below, and the displacement points straight at it.

take.why: Liquidity taken, displacement, a defined entry and a draw.

location.why: Price is in the premium of yesterday's range after the overnight rally: where a bearish idea wants to sell from.

next_objective.why: Price was drawn to the previous day low (21,942.5); it also traded to the day's low (22,036.75) on the way, which makes those defensible too. The question is where price was likely to be pulled, not what the next candle would do. A previous-day extreme is also a pool of buy-side or sell-side liquidity, so that answer is right on the side, if less exact.

annotations.label: Overnight high 22,191.75
annotations.why: Obvious buy-side liquidity, and exactly where the open swept it.
annotations.decisionNote: The sweep is the trigger. Without it this is just a short in a trend.

annotations.label: Previous day low 21,942.5
annotations.why: The pool below and the draw: sell stops resting under yesterday's low.
annotations.decisionNote: Sets the target, and with the entry sets whether the trade clears 2R.

annotations.label: Sweep high 22,205
annotations.why: The extreme of the sweep. If price takes it out the idea is wrong, which makes it the stop reference.

annotations.label: 5m bearish FVG from the displacement
annotations.why: The displacement candle left a gap and closed below the last 5m low. A retrace into it is the entry model.
annotations.decisionNote: The edge is in the retrace: a better price and a shorter stop than anything after the move.

annotations.label: 5m order block above the gap
annotations.why: The last up candle before the displacement. An acceptable alternative area, sitting above the gap.

annotations.label: 1H bearish FVG the sweep ran into
annotations.why: The sweep took the high inside a 1H gap: higher-timeframe resistance over the whole idea.

annotations.label: 5m bullish FVG at 09:55
annotations.why: A gap against the move, left by the retrace. It looks like a long and is just the pullback.
annotations.whyNot: A gap that forms against displacement is a retrace, not a reason to trade it.

annotations.label: London low 22,036.75
annotations.why: Real, but sits far below and nothing here depends on it.

confluences.label: Buy-side liquidity (overnight high) swept
confluences.why: Liquidity taken is the reason there was something to sell.

confluences.label: Displacement closing below the last 5m low
confluences.why: Structure shifted after the sweep; that is the confirmation.

confluences.label: Entry area is the displacement's FVG
confluences.why: A defined area to sell with a close stop.

confluences.label: Daily and 4H trending down
confluences.why: The trade goes with the higher timeframe.

confluences.label: Sweep ran into a 1H bearish FVG
Bullish 5m FVG at 09:55
confluences.why: A pullback gap against the move; it changes nothing.

confluences.label: A round number just under price
confluences.why: A round number is not a reason to buy or sell.

trade.confirmationLabel: the displacement that closed below the last 5m low

lookFor: Liquidity taken, then displacement through a recent swing: in that order, on either side of the market.
Short from the gap the displacement left, not from a market order after the move.
Name the draw before you enter: here, the previous day low.
